export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for slug 'rane-madras-limited' (https://importkey.com/countries/india/rane-madras-limited): 'Total Shipments 15529 Records detected', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28'. Exact row quoted: '2026-02-28 | RANE (MADRAS) LIMITED | KAWASAKI MOTORS MFG.CORP.USA | 5515 BALL JOINTS - CUSTOMER PART NO : 59266-0738 - RML PART NO : 1211698013- CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India | Lincoln, UNITED STATES | 87089900 | 1143672'. Additional rows seen: 2026-02-28 BRP-ST-PHILIPPE, Montreal, Canada, HS 87089900, BOL 1144329 (ball joint assembly); 2026-02-28 BRP MEXICO S.A DE C.V, Los Angeles, MEXICO, HS 87089400, BOL 1144145 (steering gear assy); 2026-02-28 JIAXING CIJU, Shanghai, CHINA, HS 87083000, BOL 1113317 (brake pads). Counter: page states 15,529 total shipments; 4 individual rows actually rendered on the free view. Declared HS 870899 matches the main export line (ball joints, HS 87089900); other lines carry 87089400/87083000, consistent with a multi-product auto-component maker.
domestic_evidence: Rane Group investor page (https://www.ranegroup.com/investor/rane-madras-limited/): 'The Company is listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE symbol: RML) and on BSE Limited (BSE Scrip Code:532661).' Same page lists audited results and annual reports for FY2018-19 through FY2025-26 and CRISIL ratings 'Long term rating 120.00 AA- Stable Revised July 09,2026 / Short term rating 965.00 A1+'. Domestic supply is evidenced by the fact that the company is an OEM tier-1 supplier to Indian vehicle makers (Rane Group page: 'trusted manufacturer of safety and critical auto components') and by the amalgamation of Rane Engine Valve Limited into Rane (Madras) Limited (site notice: 'Rane Engine Valve Limited has been amalgamated with and into Rane (Madras) Limited'), which brings in domestic OEM supply volumes. Exact GST turnover band and the domestic/export revenue split were NOT retrieved: the annual-report PDFs were not opened and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable during this run, so revenue figures are left null rather than estimated.
note: Legal entity exists and is active: listed on NSE (RML) and BSE (532661), CRISIL ratings re-affirmed as recently as 29.12.2025 and revised 09.07.2026, and NCLT-approved amalgamation of Rane Engine Valve Ltd into it (certified copy 24.03.2025). Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with B/L numbers, destination ports and HS codes — not merely claimed on a website. Domestic supply is confirmed at the level of an operating listed OEM supplier with audited financials, but the specific GST turnover band and domestic-vs-export revenue split are null (not public in the pages read; search tooling failed). Revenue: null — not verified in this run. Declared HS 870899 is correct for the main ball-joint line; the company also ships 870894/870830, so the HS code should be treated as a primary code, not exclusive. No rejection grounds.
